verdict.rationale: SolidJS's fine-grained reactivity model compiles JSX into direct DOM update instructions rather than using a virtual DOM diff, evidenced by 'only the code that depends on it will rerun', real DOM elements accessible via devtools, and community reports of it realizing 'fine-grained reactive updates' with next-level DOM performance and top benchmark results. Multiple developers confirm this eliminates manual diffing/memoization patterns (no useMemo/useCallback needed), though some note rough edges in reactivity ergonomics.
